title: Integrative analysis of histopathological images and chromatin accessibility data for estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer.
summary: Primary BMC Medical Genomics Methods/Results integrate CNN-derived epithelial proportions with matched ATAC-seq and RNA-seq; 436 regions/74 target genes correlate with epithelial proportion and combined image+gene features stratify survival. Only 54 paired cases support peak discovery and causality is untested.
